itemDialog.mountedVehicleHint: Optional. Indicate if this purchase is already on a car.

partDialog.title: Edit part
partDialog.description: Changes to name, brand, reference and technical data apply to inventory lines and parts mounted on cars. Quantities and prices are not changed.
